acceptance_criteria.criterion: Self-referential and mutually cyclic supported arrays, plain objects, and Sets throw the documented CanonicalEncoderError contract.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: canonical.ts performs active-path identity detection before descent and throws E_CYCLE with message 'cyclic container is not admitted'; hostile-cycle.test.mjs covers direct and cross-container cycles, and the 171-test validation passed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Repeated references outside the active traversal path encode identically to duplicated-by-value structures.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Containers are removed from activeStack in finally blocks; hostile-cycle.test.mjs verifies shared object, Array, Set, and deeply nested references against duplicated-by-value equivalents.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Enumerable own accessors on top-level, nested, and null-prototype plain objects are rejected without invocation.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: encodePlainObject inspects captured property descriptors and rejects enumerable accessors with E_ACCESSOR_DESCRIPTOR before reading descriptor.value; hostile-object.test.mjs verifies getter/setter counters remain zero.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Cycle detection, descriptor inspection, and traversal rely only on captured intrinsics and execute no user hook.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: capturedParseInt10 reads Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER and Number.NaN dynamically. Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER is consulted while traversing every nonzero array index, so replacing it after import with an accessor can execute user code and influence admission.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: All pre-existing tests and all new focused tests pass.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Automated validation reports 171 tests, 171 passed, with no failures, skips, or todos. SPEC_BLOCKERS.md documents the contradictory '157 pre-existing tests' count and records that all 44 actual baseline tests remain intact and passing.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The exact candidate passes lint, strict compile/typecheck, and dependency-boundary commands.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Automated validation independently shows lint passing, but contains no compile or boundary execution. The Implementer report states both passed but supplies only summarized claims rather than captured command output.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No StateHash or SaveHash implementation is added.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: The candidate adds only CanonicalEncoder exports and implementation; the ADR expressly defers StateHash and SaveHash.

findings.evidence: In canonical.ts, capturedParseInt10 returns Number.NaN and compares against Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER at call time. For an array containing index '1', a post-import accessor installed on Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER is invoked during traversal, contradicting ADR-009 §1/§6 and the task's zero-user-code requirement.
findings.required_change: Capture the required numeric constants at module initialization or eliminate those mutable global-property reads. Add a focused post-import monkeypatch test using a throwing/counting Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER accessor and verify canonical array encoding and cycle rejection remain unchanged with zero accessor invocations.
findings.title: Array traversal reads uncaptured mutable Number properties

findings.evidence: The supplied automated validation ran dependency installation, diff check, lint, and tests only. It explicitly warns that no typecheck/build script was run, and contains no output for npm run compile or npm run boundary. Implementer summaries alone do not independently establish execution on the exact candidate state.
findings.required_change: Run and record npm run compile and npm run boundary on the corrected exact candidate state, including exit codes and command output, alongside lint and the complete test suite.

invariants_checked: Active-path cycles are rejected rather than serialized
Non-active shared references encode by value
Canonical object and Set ordering remains construction-order independent
Enumerable own accessors are rejected before descriptor values are read
Set and Array iterator overrides are not used
Proxy containers are rejected before reflective traversal
No StateHash or SaveHash implementation was introduced
TASK-0006 test-count contradiction is recorded under the §19 blocker protocol
risks: A caller can install an accessor on Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER after module import and cause canonical array traversal to execute user code or throw a native/user error.
Without independently captured compile and boundary results, type or architecture regressions are not conclusively excluded.
payload.summary: The cycle and accessor behavior is substantially implemented, but traversal still reads a mutable global property after module initialization, violating the captured-intrinsics and no-user-code-execution acceptance criterion. Required compile and boundary validation also lacks independently supplied command output.
